const seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000000000);

const topics = [
  'When Did Ancient Humans Start Smoking?',
  'When Did Ancient Humans First Drink Alcohol?',
  'Why Did Humans Start Hiding Sex And When?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Actually Find Privacy?',
  'What Did Ancient Humans Do All Day With No Jobs?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Survive Without Modern Medicine?',
  'Why Did Ancient Humans Start Wearing Clothes?',
  'Why Ancient Humans Slept Better Than Us',
  'Ancient Humans vs Modern Humans: Who Had The Easier Life?',
  'Why Ancient Humans Had Better Teeth Without Ever Brushing',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Deal With Death?',
  'Why Did Ancient Humans Start Cooking Food?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Fall In Love?',
  'What Did Ancient Humans Fear The Most?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Raise Their Children?',
  'Why Did Ancient Humans Start Believing In Gods?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Communicate Before Language?',
  'What Did Ancient Humans Eat In A Typical Day?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Handle Anger And Conflict?',
  'Why Did Ancient Humans Start Making Art?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Stay Warm Without Heating?',
  'Did Ancient Humans Actually Have Fun?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Know When Someone Was Lying?',
  'Why Did Ancient Humans Live In Groups?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Deal With Boredom?',
  'What Happened When An Ancient Human Got Sick?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Know What Was Safe To Eat?',
  'Why Did Ancient Humans Start Burying Their Dead?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Treat Mental Illness?',
  'What Did Ancient Humans Think About Dreams?',
  'Did Ancient Humans Have Best Friends?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Handle Heartbreak?',
  'What Did Ancient Humans Do When It Rained?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans React To Thunder And Lightning?',
  'Did Ancient Humans Get Depressed?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Choose A Leader?',
  'What Did Ancient Humans Do For Fun At Night?',
  'Why Did Ancient Humans Start Dancing?',
  'How Did Ancient Humans Know When To Sleep?'
];

const voices = ['en-US-GuyNeural', 'en-US-ChristopherNeural'];
const topic = topics[seed % topics.length];
const voice = voices[Math.floor(seed / 13) % voices.length];

return [{
  json: {
    seed, topic, voice,
    groqModel: 'openai/gpt-oss-120b',
    targetMinutes: 13, minMinutes: 11, maxMinutes: 15,
    targetScenes: 55, minScenes: 45, maxScenes: 65,
    minWords: 1700, maxWords: 2200,
    character_style: 'Ancient Thoughts / Mack Explains style: white circle head, wild spiky black hair, scruffy beard, simple brown animal-pelt tunic, thick black marker stick-figure limbs, hilarious meme-face reactions',
    prop_style: 'flat-colour minimal props: stylised fire with curling smoke, crossed-out modern items labelled NO NETFLIX and NO PHONE, dotted evolution timeline arrow',
    visual_style: 'pure white background, thick black outlines, flat colour fills, no gradients, no photorealism, no 3D, no shadows, no watermark'
  }
}];

const d = $json;
const claims = d.researchClaims || d.research?.claims || [];
const facts = claims.slice(0, 6).map(c => c.safe_wording || c.claim).join('; ');

const system = [
  'You are a YouTube scriptwriter for Ancient Thoughts and Mack Explains channels.',
  'Style: rapid-fire educational comedy. Short punchy sentences 15-35 words each.',
  'Structure: alternate between ancient-human facts and modern-human comparisons.',
  'Hook every 4-5 scenes with a surprising did-you-know reveal.',
  'Output ONLY raw JSON. No markdown. No code fences. Start with { end with }.'
].join(' ');

const user = [
  'TOPIC: ' + d.topic,
  'FACTS: ' + facts,
  '',
  'Write exactly 55 scenes. Rules:',
  '- narration: 15-35 words, punchy conversational. Mix fast 15-20w and medium 25-35w.',
  '- caption: 3-6 word UPPERCASE summary burned onto screen.',
  '- visual_action: one vivid cartoon image description. End with ONE tag: [CAMP] [MODERN] [COMPARE] [REACTION] [TIMELINE]',
  '  [CAMP]=ancient campfire/savanna  [MODERN]=modern human relatable  [COMPARE]=side-by-side',
  '  [REACTION]=meme face close-up    [TIMELINE]=evolution arrow diagram',
  '- camera: static or slow_zoom_in or slow_zoom_out',
  '',
  'Scene 1: open with vivid sensory hook 50000 years ago.',
  'Scenes 2-4: establish ancient situation.',
  'Every 5th scene: modern comparison gag.',
  'Final 3 scenes: punchy takeaway.',
  '',
  'RESPOND WITH EXACTLY:',
  '{"topic":"...","youtube_title":"...","title_candidates":["...","...","...","...","..."],',
  '"youtube_description":"...","youtube_tags":["...","...","...","...","...","...","...","...","...","..."],',
  '"thumbnail_prompt":"...","hook":"...",',
  '"scenes":[{"n":1,"narration":"...","caption":"CAPTION HERE","visual_action":"description [CAMP]","camera":"slow_zoom_in"}],',
  '"shorts":[{"short_id":1,"title":"...","description":"...","hook":"...","start_scene":1,"end_scene":8}]}'
].join('\n');

const model = d.groqModel || 'openai/gpt-oss-120b';
const scriptBody = {
  model,
  messages: [{ role: 'system', content: system }, { role: 'user', content: user }],
  temperature: 1,
  max_tokens: 32000
};
return [{ json: { ...d, scriptBody } }];

parameters.command:
set -e;
VDIR="/home/node/.n8n-files/video_tmp";
mkdir -p "$VDIR";

python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import glob, re, subprocess, os, random, time
vdir = '/home/node/.n8n-files/video_tmp'
deadline = time.time() + 1800
last_count = -1; stable_since = 0
while time.time() < deadline:
    files = [f for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(vdir,'scene_*_out.mp4')) if os.path.getsize(f)>50000]
    n = len(files)
    if n >= 15 and n == last_count:
        if stable_since == 0: stable_since = time.time()
        elif time.time() - stable_since >= 10: print(f'Scenes stable at {n}'); break
    else: stable_since = 0
    last_count = n; print(f'Waiting: {n} scenes...'); time.sleep(12)
def get_num(f):
    m = re.search(r'scene_(\d+)_out\.mp4', f); return int(m.group(1)) if m else -1
files = sorted([f for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(vdir,'scene_*_out.mp4')) if os.path.getsize(f)>50000], key=get_num)
assert len(files) >= 15, f'Too few scenes: {len(files)}'
print(f'Assembling {len(files)} scenes')
cp = os.path.join(vdir,'concat_main.txt')
with open(cp,'w') as fh:
    for f in files: fh.write(f"file '{os.path.basename(f)}'\n")
out_mp4 = '/home/node/.n8n-files/final_video.mp4'
music_files = glob.glob('/home/node/.n8n-files/music/*.mp3') + glob.glob('/home/node/.n8n-files/music/*.m4a')
valid_music = [m for m in music_files if os.path.exists(m) and os.path.getsize(m)>50000]
if valid_music:
    music = random.choice(valid_music)
    print(f'Using music: {os.path.basename(music)}')
    cmd = ['ffmpeg','-nostdin','-y','-threads','2',
           '-f','concat','-safe','0','-i',cp,
           '-stream_loop','-1','-i',music,
           '-filter_complex','[0:a]aformat=sample_rates=48000:channel_layouts=stereo,volume=1.0[av];[1:a]aformat=sample_rates=48000:channel_layouts=stereo,volume=0.07[am];[av][am]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:normalize=0[aout]',
           '-map','0:v','-map','[aout]',
           '-c:v','copy','-c:a','aac','-b:a','192k','-movflags','+faststart',out_mp4]
else:
    cmd = ['ffmpeg','-nostdin','-y','-threads','2',
           '-f','concat','-safe','0','-i',cp,
           '-c:v','copy','-c:a','aac','-b:a','192k','-movflags','+faststart',out_mp4]
subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, cwd=vdir)
sz = os.path.getsize(out_mp4)
assert sz > 1000000, f'Output too small: {sz}'
print(f'Final video: {sz//1024//1024}MB')
PYEOF
test -s /home/node/.n8n-files/final_video.mp4
ls -lh /home/node/.n8n-files/final_video.mp4

set -e
test -s /home/node/.n8n-files/final_video.mp4
echo "FINAL VIDEO VERIFIED"
ls -lh /home/node/.n8n-files/final_video.mp4

set -e; FILE=/home/node/.n8n-files/final_video.mp4; test -s "$FILE"; D=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=nk=1:nw=1 "$FILE"); W=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=width -of csv=p=0 "$FILE"); H=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams v:0 -show_entries stream=height -of csv=p=0 "$FILE"); A=$(ffprobe -v error -select_streams a:0 -show_entries stream=codec_name -of csv=p=0 "$FILE"); SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$FILE"); echo "duration=$D width=$W height=$H audio=$A size=$SIZE"; [ "$W" = "1920" ]; [ "$H" = "1080" ]; [ -n "$A" ]; [ "$SIZE" -gt 1000000 ]; awk -v d="$D" 'BEGIN { if(d<240||d>1800){print "ERROR: runtime outside range";exit 1} }'; echo 'FINAL VIDEO QC PASSED'

set -e;
GEMINI_KEY="${GEMINI_API_KEY:-}";

python3 - "$GEMINI_KEY" <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, urllib.request, urllib.parse, urllib.error, subprocess, os, base64, re

gemini_key = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ''

topic          = """{{ $('⏱️ Final Runtime Check').first().json.topic || 'Ancient Human Survival' }}"""
thumb_prompt   = """{{ $('⏱️ Final Runtime Check').first().json.thumbnail_prompt || '' }}"""
seed_val       = {{ $('⏱️ Final Runtime Check').first().json.seed || 12345 }}

out_file = '/home/node/.n8n-files/thumbnail.png'
raw_file = '/home/node/.n8n-files/thumbnail_raw.png'

# ── Build thumbnail prompt ────────────────────────────────────────────
subject = (thumb_prompt if thumb_prompt.strip() else topic).strip()
subject = re.sub(r'[\"\']', '', subject)[:120]

THUMB_PROMPT = (
    f'YouTube thumbnail illustration for: {subject}. '
    'Two stick-figure cavemen with wild spiky black hair, round white heads, '
    'and brown animal-pelt tunics react with hilarious shock expressions — '
    'huge O-shaped eyes, mouths wide open, hands raised. '
    'Bright burning orange campfire in the foreground. '
    'Flat savanna horizon at sunset, warm orange and yellow sky. '
    '2D flat vector cartoon style, thick black outlines, '
    'bold saturated colours, pure white or light background. '
    'No text, no watermark, no logo. '
    'Style: Ancient Thoughts YouTube channel thumbnail art.'
)

# ── Try Gemini Imagen API first ───────────────────────────────────────
gemini_ok = False
if gemini_key and gemini_key != 'YOUR_GEMINI_API_KEY_HERE':
    try:
        url = f'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/imagen-3.0-generate-001:predict?key={gemini_key}'
        payload = json.dumps({
            'instances': [{'prompt': THUMB_PROMPT}],
            'parameters': {
                'sampleCount': 1,
                'aspectRatio': '16:9',
                'personGeneration': 'allow_all',
                'safetyFilterLevel': 'block_only_high'
            }
        }).encode()
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url, data=payload,
            headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
            method='POST'
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
            result = json.loads(resp.read())
        b64 = result['predictions'][0]['bytesBase64Encoded']
        with open(raw_file, 'wb') as fh:
            fh.write(base64.b64decode(b64))
        if os.path.getsize(raw_file) > 5000:
            gemini_ok = True
            print('Gemini Imagen: OK')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Gemini Imagen failed: {e} — falling back to Pollinations')

# ── Fallback: Pollinations flux ───────────────────────────────────────
if not gemini_ok:
    q = urllib.parse.quote(THUMB_PROMPT)
    neg = urllib.parse.quote('text, watermark, logo, photorealistic, 3D render, dark background')
    seed_str = str(seed_val)
    for model_n, timeout in [('flux', 60), ('turbo', 30)]:
        try:
            url = (f'https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/{q}'
                   f'?width=1280&height=720&model={model_n}'
                   f'&nologo=true&nofeed=true&seed={seed_str}&negative={neg}')
            r = subprocess.run(
                ['curl','-fsSL','--retry','2','--connect-timeout','12',
                 '--max-time',str(timeout),'-o',raw_file,url],
                timeout=timeout+8
            )
            if r.returncode==0 and os.path.exists(raw_file) and os.path.getsize(raw_file)>2000:
                print(f'Pollinations {model_n}: OK')
                break
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'Pollinations {model_n} failed: {e}')

# ── Resize to exact 1280x720 ──────────────────────────────────────────
if os.path.exists(raw_file) and os.path.getsize(raw_file) > 2000:
    subprocess.run([
        'ffmpeg','-nostdin','-y','-i',raw_file,
        '-vf','scale=1280:720:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase:flags=lanczos,crop=1280:720',
        '-frames:v','1', out_file
    ], check=True, timeout=15)
    if os.path.exists(raw_file): os.remove(raw_file)
    print(f'Thumbnail saved: {os.path.getsize(out_file)//1024}KB')
else:
    # Last resort: white frame
    subprocess.run([
        'ffmpeg','-nostdin','-y','-f','lavfi',
        '-i','color=c=white:s=1280x720:d=1',
        '-frames:v','1', out_file
    ], check=True, timeout=10)
    print('WARNING: used white fallback thumbnail')

if os.path.exists(out_file) and os.path.getsize(out_file)>500:
    print(f'Thumbnail OK: {os.path.getsize(out_file)//1024}KB')
else:
    print('Thumbnail generation skipped — workflow continues')
    open(out_file,'wb').close()  # create empty file so test -s has a target
PYEOF
# thumbnail step complete (soft — workflow always continues)
true
